title: Emotion2Skill: Model-Internal Emotion Signals for Adaptive Skill Selection and Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2608.09248v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Skill-based LLM agents select reusable procedures from external libraries to solve complex tasks, yet their routing decisions rely primarily on task descriptions, verbal reflections, and experience-derived rules, without explicitly observing the model's internal decision state. Recent interpretability work has identified emotion representations that influence model behavior, but their use has largely focused on post-hoc analysis and output steering. Their potential to guide agent-level decisions remains underexplored. We propose Emotion2Skill, a framework that extracts LLM-internal emotion vectors and incorporates them into both skill selection and skill evolution. The framework uses these representations to inform skill choice and tracks their changes to identify problematic invocations, enabling targeted skill refinement beyond coarse outcome feedback. translated_title: Emotion2Skill：利用模型内部情感信号实现自适应技能选择与演化
translated_abstract: 基于技能的LLM智能体通过从外部库中选择可复用的程序来解决复杂任务，然而其路由决策主要依赖任务描述、语言反思和经验推导的规则，而未能显式观察模型的内部决策状态。近期的可解释性研究已经识别出影响模型行为的情感表征，但其应用大多集中于事后分析和输出引导，其在引导智能体层面决策方面的潜力仍未被充分探索。我们提出Emotion2Skill，一个提取LLM内部情感向量并将其融入技能选择与技能演化的框架。该框架利用这些表征来指导技能选择，并通过追踪其变化来识别有问题的调用，从而实现超越粗粒度结果反馈的针对性技能优化。在两个骨干模型上，Emotion2Skill均优于七个基线方法。在Qwen3-8B上，它
tldr: 该论文提出Emotion2Skill框架，通过提取LLM内部情感向量并追踪其变化来指导智能体的技能选择与针对性技能演化，在两个骨干模型上超越了七个基线方法。
en_tdlr: Emotion2Skill extracts LLM-internal emotion vectors and tracks their dynamics to guide adaptive skill selection and targeted skill evolution for LLM agents, outperforming seven baselines across two backbones.
